title: Drive the unit to delivery autonomously; predict the stops now; a paused question lives on the desk; the holon is marked in progress (2026-10-28)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
Good. Keep going.  If possible drive this all the way. Be autonomous.

We have already sorted all.yhe decisions. If there are any other points that we can predict will cause a stop..
Let's address them now. 
Otherwise, your goal is to deliver. 
We are exploring how to build the flow. 
What do we need in place to take a concept through to delivery without getting lost. 

If we do need to pause and ask a question, the decision needs to be somewhere where it can be found easily. (On the desk?) 
We need to have a holon of work clearly marked as in progress so that it gets driven to finish
